maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new semiconductor process equipment system sales (MOCVD, laser annealing, ion beam, lithography); service is the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private semiconductor, compound semi, data storage and packaging manufacturers; revenue is paid by commercial companies.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own equipment development and sales; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Process tools are qualified into customers' fabs; switching needs re-qualification and risks yield and downtime.
